checks.label: Publish checklist
checks.help: What a product needs before it may go on the shop. "block" stops publishing until it is done, "warn" only reminds, "off" does not check. Checks: category, variants with an SKU, a price on every variant, the photo set, a size chart, a fabric, SEO title and description, a description, stock.

weights.label: Health score: how much each check counts
weights.help: The health score is the share of these points a product has. A check that is off does not count.

bands.label: Health score colours
bands.help: At or above "good" the score shows green; at or above "fair" it shows amber; below it shows red.

maxProducts.label: Most products in one bulk action
maxProducts.help: Publish, take off, recheck or archive at most this many products in one go.

pageSize.label: Products per page in the admin
pageSize.help: How many products the product list and the publish queue show at a time.

lowStockPieces.label: "Almost out" means this many pieces or fewer
lowStockPieces.help: A size with at least one and at most this many pieces counts as almost out on the product list.

issuesShown.label: Missing items shown on each product row
issuesShown.help: How many of a product's missing items the list shows as small tags (the product page shows all of them).

skuSuggestion.label: Suggested SKU for a new variant
skuSuggestion.help: Only a suggestion — the ERP's SKU is the real one. {style} is the ERP style code, {colour} and {size} the colour's and size's ERP code (or their key).
